Failure.about: Failure is an American alternative rock band from Los Angeles, formed in 1990. Its 1996 album Fantastic Planet became a cult favorite after the band split the next year.

Francis of Delirium.about: Francis of Delirium is an indie rock band from Luxembourg, formed in 2019.

The Tubs.about: The Tubs are a post-punk band from London, formed in 2018 by former members of Joanna Gruesome.
